name: Arlong
effect: [DON!! x1] [Activate: Main] You may rest this Character: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand; your opponent reveals that card. If the revealed card is an Event, place up to 1 card from your opponent's Life area at the bottom of the owner's deck.

official_faq.question: Can I activate this Character's "You may rest this Character:" effect on the turn it is played?
When choosing a card from my opponent's hand, should their hand remain face-down?
official_faq.answer: Yes. Choose a card without seeing the faces of the cards in your opponent's hand.

official_faq.question: Can my opponent rearrange the order of the cards in their hand when I am selecting 1 card from their hand?
If my opponent has no cards in their hand, can I use this [Activate: Main] effect to reduce my opponent's Life cards?
official_faq.answer: No, you cannot. You can activate the effect, but nothing will happen.
